title: A vector's narrative must not contradict its recorded verdict
goal: check-roadmap-progress.sh catches one placeholder contradiction, for vectors with closed tasks. Now that outcomes are recorded per vector in .agents/roadmap-verdicts/, the stronger consistency is checkable and ought to fail CI: a vector with a delivered verdict whose narrative does not claim delivery, or a vector refuted on record whose narrative still claims it. Coverage is not completion in both directions, and the roadmap is the artifact a human reads. Add the rule to the queue checker, which already reads both files, with a --self-test pinning all four combinations.
